response.original_title: [Complete-Escalate] Disney Cruise Customer Service Escalation: Refunds, Billing & Booking Issues
response.overview: To escalate an issue or speak with customer support for Disney Cruise Line, you can call the main US customer service (866) 254-7549 and reservations number at (866) 254-7549 or the alternative corporate/shoreside line at (866) 254-7549.How to Escalate an Issue Call Support: Dial (866) 254-7549 (available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Saturday and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time).Request a Supervisor: If the representative cannot resolve your problem (866) 254-7549, politely ask to be transferred to a supervisor or guest relations manager. Submit Online: Use the official Disney Cruise Line Email Us portal to create a written paper trail of your complaint (866) 254-7549.
